changes: Added purpose 'bhāratīmudā' (for the delight of Bhāratī/Sarasvatī), which the first reading left empty
Expanded the notes: the chronogram read right to left gives 767 (śaila 7, ṣaṣṭha 6, muni 7); the dual -ābhyām shows two scribes; the figure 867 would give 1747 CE
Persons, roles, date, era and ce_approx (767 + 880 = 1647) confirmed

notes: The figures and the chronogram disagree. Read right to left, the chronogram śaila (7) – ṣaṣṭha (6, an unusual use of an ordinal) – muni (7) gives NS 767 = c. 1647 CE. The figure 867 would give 1747 CE. It may be a misreading by the cataloguer or a scribal slip; the cataloguer's '[767]' follows the chronogram. The dual 'vinodānantasiṃhābhyāṃ' shows two scribes, Vinoda and Anantasiṃha. No relationship between them is stated.
